Maya: FYI noticed a regression after the KV compaction sweep rate bump to 0.25 — seeing p99 spikes in long-seq mixed batching runs
Maya: repro is on nightly-run `perf/longseq-mixed-batch` (seeded workload) — tail spikes around step ~1200
Maya: stack from profiler looks like frequent reallocs + kernel fallback churn:
```
GPU alloc count: +18%
KV evictions/min: 72 -> 210
kernel_switches: aten_gemm_fp16 -> fallback_kernel x ~3/min
aligned_workspace_faults: 12 -> 67
```
Owen: can you paste the exact config you changed? was it only `kv.compaction.sweep_rate`?
Maya: yes, changed `kv.compaction.sweep_rate=0.25` (was 0.05). also enabled `allocator.eager_reuse=false` in the same patch to test compact mode.
Li: hmm. faster sweep -> more compaction -> more small-block frees and then allocator fails to reuse leading to fresh allocations that prevent batched kernels from keeping consistent workspace sizes. that explains kernel_switches and aligned_workspace_faults
Sam: +1. probably breaking the batching size distribution which the kernel-selector uses to pick the optimized kernel. When batch shape jitter increases, selector falls back to safe slower kernel to avoid OOMs
Maya: ran a quick experiment reverting sweep_rate to 0.05 but keeping eager_reuse=false — p99 dropped back but p50 moved a bit up. numbers: p99 520ms -> 160ms, p50 62ms -> 74ms
Owen: can you run with `workspace.size_hint=auto` off and a fixed `workspace.target_bytes=1.2GB` to see if stabilizing workspace helps? also add metric `workspace_stability_ratio` (stable_allocs/total_allocs)
Maya: running now, will push results in ~20m. repro command I used:
```bash
./run_perf.sh --scenario longseq-mixed-batch --seed 42 --profile gpu --kv-sweep 0.25 --alloc-eager-reuse=false
```
Li: short-term mitigations: 1) lower sweep_rate OR 2) enable eager_reuse (reduces churn) OR 3) increase workspace target so kernel selector sees consistent shapes. Long-term we should make kernel selector tolerate eviction noise by smoothing recent workspace histograms
Sam: agree — adding a small exponential moving average to the shape histogram before kernel choice would reduce flip-flopping. could also gate compaction to avoid compacting blocks used by active prefixes (prefix protection window)
Maya: quick numbers from the workspace-target run: `workspace.target_bytes=1.2GB` gave p99 180ms, workspace_stability_ratio 0.86 -> baseline 0.4 when sweep=0.25. so stabilizing helps a lot
Maya: will open a small RFC with experiments: revert sweep bump in prod, re-enable eager_reuse, and add a canary that tests `workspace.target_bytes` changes and the smoothing hist for kernel selection. cc @Owen @Li for review :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Perf job posted: https://ci.internal/runs/longseq-mixed/1719877000 — artifacts + profiler attached
Owen: thanks Maya — let's keep the sweep rate conservative until we have protection for active prefix blocks. also add trace tag `kv_eviction_cause` in next run so we can see if evictions are from compaction or from explicit eviction policy
Maya: good call, will include that in the RFC and the next perf run
Sam: tiny note: when you open the RFC link the mini repro and a flame graph snippet would help the oncall and SRE quickly triage if it recurs after deploy
Maya: yup adding flame graph and a compact reproducer script in the RFC
